latest.title: Minimal Two-Spheres and Manifolds with Positive Isotropic Curvature
latest.abstract: We improve the Micallef--Moore index estimate for harmonic two-spheres in $n$-manifolds with positive isotropic curvature to the sharp bound $n-3$. Combining with recent work, this completes the diffeomorphism classification of closed manifolds with positive isotropic curvature in the remaining dimensions five and six.
latest.workSummary: 将正迷向曲率流形中调和二球的指标界提高到锐利 n-3，并据既有工作补齐五六维微分同胚分类。
latest.breakthrough: 强化 Micallef–Moore 机制，推动低维剩余分类。
latest.limitations: 完整分类还依赖引用结果；需区分正迷向与正截面曲率。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.aiEvidence: AI 工具声明披露 GPT 仅建议了相关平滑结果，文稿与数学论证由作者完成。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.06910v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
latest.priorityReason: 曲率到拓扑分类的重要连接，优先级很高。
